categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Friendcom Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the IoT (Internet of Things) sector, focusing on smart metering and intelligent IoT solutions for utilities such as electricity, water, gas, and heat. The company’s main business segments include low-voltage electricity metering and information collection, low and medium voltage distribution smart IoT, power transmission and transformation smart IoT, and public utility metering, especially ultrasonic gas metering. It also provides smart city solutions including smart traffic and smart lighting poles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IoT communication technologies such as MuCoFAN (multi-mode & deep-coverage field area network), CFDA (cellular fixed-wireless digital access), L-CFDA (low power CFDA), and integrates multiple communication protocols including HPLC, LoRa, Zigbee, and RS-485. It employs edge computing, multi-modal communication, and wireless mesh networking for data collection and device interconnectivity. Production includes manufacturing smart meters, data collectors, concentrators, and communication modules with strict quality control systems certified by ISO9001, ISO14001, and others.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company’s primary customers are large utility companies, notably State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, serving the electricity sector predominantly. It also serves water, gas, and heat utilities, as well as smart city infrastructure providers. The company’s products are used in smart grid construction, energy management, and smart metering applications across public utilities and urban infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: Friendcom operates mainly within China, covering all provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions with a nationwide sales and service network. It also has overseas subsidiaries in the United States and Canada, focusing on expanding international markets, particularly in Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Middle East. The company’s products have been deployed in various regions domestically and are expanding globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of smart metering devices, IoT communication modules, and integrated solutions for utilities and smart cities. It acts as a technology provider and equipment manufacturer supplying to utility companies and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Friendcom emphasizes continuous R&D investment in IoT communication technologies, smart metering, ultrasonic gas metering, and edge computing. It pursues innovation in multi-modal communication networks and aims to enhance product reliability and interoperability. The company is committed to expanding its technology ecosystem (FAN+), integrating AI with IoT (AIoT), and developing solutions for smart energy, smart cities, and digital infrastructure, while supporting China's carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of smart meters, IoT communication devices, and integrated solutions to utility companies and industrial customers. Sales are conducted via negotiation and bidding processes, with a direct sales model supported by regional offices and overseas business units. Revenue is mainly from product sales, with some service and solution integration components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Friendcom holds a leading position in China's smart metering and utility IoT market, especially in smart electricity meters and ultrasonic gas metering modules. It competes with domestic and international IoT and smart meter manufacturers. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, and extensive certifications provide competitive advantages. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a Guangdong famous trademark holder.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.01 billion, a slight decrease of 7.95% from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 198 million, up 3.43%. Total assets reached RMB 1.46 billion, growing 20.52% year-over-year. The company maintains a healthy profitability with a return on equity of 20.58% and continues to invest around 7.4% of revenue in R&D, indicating steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Friendcom differentiates itself through proprietary multi-modal IoT communication technologies enabling deep coverage and reliable data transmission in smart grids and utility networks. Its ultrasonic gas metering modules are domestically developed to break foreign technology monopolies, offering high precision and adaptability. The company emphasizes product quality, comprehensive certifications, and integrated smart solutions that support digital transformation and carbon neutrality, providing customers with efficient, secure, and scalable IoT infrastructure.
